queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Arabic first-party discovery found the Egyptian Survey Authority's national survey/cadastral mandate and digital-map request workflow. ESA pages, its current ASP.NET form/configuration, the national eGIS ArcGIS catalog, and the Maghagha tax-office page were inspected. No anonymous Maghagha parcel layer, native parcel identity, parcel schema/CRS, or full parcel polygon was obtained.

officialPrimarySources.scope: Official national survey and ownership-map/cadastral-register mandate.
Official digital-map request and purchase procedure.
National public GIS service catalog inspected as a general government GIS source.
Official Maghagha office coverage page; not treated as parcel geometry custody.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: No current public Maghagha parcel viewer/API configuration retrieved.

boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No verified public parcel endpoint; no parcel request formed.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if independently verified
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no coordinate shift was made.
A national authority/procedure is not proof of Maghagha-local open geometry access.
The tax-office result is not cadastral registry evidence.
No failed/absent candidate request was interpreted as citywide absence.
No source-specific raw attributes or unsafe fields were retained.
uncertainty: The national custodian and a formal digital-map access path are evidenced, but public parcel delivery, native IDs, CRS, local coverage and completeness remain unresolved. Runtime readiness is held pending independent serial qualification.
